plugin.name: Languages
plugin.description: German, French, Spanish, Arabic and more languages for the interface: language switch at the top next to light/dark, translation editor with areas, search, progress, live preview and “where is this text?”, import and export of language files (JSON) and a template for new languages.

errors.badCode: “{code}” is not a valid language code – e.g. “fr”, “es” or “pt-BR”.
errors.badJson: The file is not valid JSON: {error}
errors.sourceLanguage: English is the source language and cannot be imported.
errors.noMessages: The file has no “messages” with the texts.

editor.title: Translations
editor.importTitle: Load a language file (JSON) – English takes it as changes, any other language is created or replaced
editor.exportTitle: Download the target language as a JSON file
editor.templateTitle: Download template.json: all texts empty, the English text as a hint
editor.name: Name of the language
editor.newHint: The new language starts empty – the app shows missing texts in English. It is kept in this browser; “Export” turns it into a file.
editor.previewTitle: The app shows the target language while the editor is open – every change is visible right away
editor.placeholdersTitle: The translation must contain the same placeholders as the English text
editor.whereTitle: Where is this text? – briefly highlights it in the interface
editor.whereNone: The text is not visible right now – first open the menu, panel or tool it belongs to.
editor.storedHint: Changes are kept in this browser.
editor.confirmDelete: Delete the language “{name}” with all its translations?

i18n.templateHint: Shap3D.ai language file: fill in “code” (e.g. "fr"), “name” (e.g. "Français") and “dir” ("ltr" or "rtl") and every empty text. Lines with “#en” are only hints with the English text and may stay. Keep placeholders like {count} unchanged.
